# Quick Start Guide

This guide will help you get started with Subsetix Kokkos.

## Prerequisites

- C++20 compatible compiler (GCC 12+, Clang 15+, MSVC 2022+)
- CMake 3.25+
- Ninja build system
- Kokkos (included via FetchContent)
- Optional: CUDA Toolkit 12.x for CUDA backend
- Optional: MPI implementation for MPI variants

## Building the Project

### Serial Backend

```bash
cmake --preset serial
cmake --build --preset serial
```

### OpenMP Backend

```bash
cmake --preset openmp
cmake --build --preset openmp
```

### CUDA Backend (requires GCC 12)

```bash
cmake --preset cuda-gcc12
cmake --build --preset cuda-gcc12
```

### MPI Variants

```bash
cmake --preset mpi-serial
cmake --build --preset mpi-serial
```

## Running Tests

```bash
# Run all tests
ctest --preset serial

# Run specific test executable
./build-serial/tests/subsetix_test_core
./build-serial/tests/subsetix_test_ops
./build-serial/tests/subsetix_test_advanced
./build-serial/tests/subsetix_test_amr
```

## Running Examples

```bash
# From build directory
./build-serial/examples/<example_name>

# Examples accept --output-dir <path> to override default output location
# Most generate .vtk files in examples_output/<example_name>/
```
